source: Written 2026-09-27 as a held-out set and used once as one (bench/gate_check.py, first run); after that it became development data for the second round of gate wording. 'general' mixes kinds the gate's option text does not list (drafting, brainstorming, how-to, explanations, opinions); 'personal' are generic-sounding requests where what the assistant knows about the user should shape the reply, so memory should be allowed in.
